mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and consumer price index signal aggressive monetary tightening with rising inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise by at least 0.25pp and 0.5 points respectively in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: During strong housing market activity (HOUST above 2200 thousand units), a rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic growth supporting corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 2200 and INDPRO rises by at least 0.5 points in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past 3 months indicates improving labor market conditions boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 persons over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5 points signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain disruptions reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls by more than 0.5 points in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate strong consumer demand supporting corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise by at least 5% and 0.5% respectively in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL rising above 0.5 points per month), a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5 points and FEDFUNDS >= last month's value
regime_hint: high inflation with restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5 points and FEDFUNDS does not fall in the past month.
